title: jmap-server: metadata-04 plumbing (using, get_changes params, updatedProperties)
description: Foundation for JMAP-s4kp (Mark 2026-10-23, option A). In jmap-server: add `using` to CallContext, filled by Dispatcher::dispatch. handle_changes parses ignoreMetadataOnlyChanges and passes jmap_metadata_server::MetadataOnlyChanges (or an equivalent jmap-server type) to the backend: change JmapBackend::get_changes to take a #[non_exhaustive] params struct like QueryParams (BREAKING for every JmapBackend impl in the workspace; update all). Add updated_properties: Option<Vec<String>> to ChangesResult; handle_changes emits updatedProperties whenever using contains urn:ietf:params:jmap:metadata (-04 §3.3: always present, null when updated is empty). Tests from -04 spec text.
